caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass goblet positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The goblet has a round, wide base that is slightly thickened at the edges, a short, rounded stem with a small spherical node near its center, and a bowl that gradually widens upward before tapering inwards at the top, ending in a small circular opening. The entire goblet is rendered with subtle gray shading and transparent effects to indicate the appearance of glass, with the highlights and contours carefully illustrated. There are no additional objects, patterns, or colors other than the neutral tones of the background and the varying grays used for the glass form and reflections.
title: Spark Lamp
